title: PONR latch refuses rollback-repoint with POST_PONR_INELIGIBLE despite tmp deletion + fabricated convex data-plane-config
classification: Asymmetry: loadPostExportWriteAudit is fail-open on missing .tmp audit; POST_PONR_INELIGIBLE is DB SELECT-backed and survives filesystem tampering

observed.contrast: Pre-PONR fail-open: deleting post-export-write-audit.json reports zero accepted writes. Post-PONR: DELETE of all .tmp artifacts still yields POST_PONR_INELIGIBLE from Postgres SELECT.
